title: Formal Purpose: A Fin de Que and Con el Objeto de Que
goal: State a purpose with a fin de que and con el objeto de que, with the right subjunctive tense.
grammar: Purpose with two subjects: a fin de que, con el objeto de que

items: I can state a purpose with a fin de que and con el objeto de que and the right subjunctive tense.
I can choose the present or the imperfect subjunctive from the main verb.
I can use the new words for aims and goals.
